faq.paragraph: Here, we provide answers to some common questions. Feel free to reach out if you have more questions or need further assistance.
faq.content_1: Pepu is a new educational platform aimed at supporting students for better learning outcomes and achieving higher grades.
faq.content_2: Support for students to improve their grades, better self-assessment, and achieving higher grades.
faq.title_3: Is Pepu free, or do I need to pay for it?
faq.content_3: When signing up and registering on Pepu, you can use it for free for a limited time. However, for continued success in Pepu and to access more features, you need to subscribe to one of Pepu's packages, which offers affordable rates for students.
faq.title_4: Why do I need to pay for Pepu?
faq.content_4: Pepu provides a high-quality and well-structured educational service that requires financial support to maintain its quality and continuous development. Currently, over 20 people work on Pepu to improve and enhance the system for better learning outcomes and an easier experience for users.
faq.title_5: What is the cost of subscribing to Pepu?
faq.content_5: The subscription cost for a Pepu package is approximately 9,000 Iraqi Dinars for a three-month period. Subsequent package renewals are only 3,000 Iraqi Dinars per month.
faq.title_6: What benefits do I get from upgrading to one of these packages?

content_6.point1: Access to more than 2,500 specialized questions from ministries and various subjects
content_6.point2: Achieving self-assessment and time management for questions and answers
content_6.point3: Selecting questions by subject and chapter
content_6.point4: Several themes and supplementary information for students to better understand the material
content_6.point6: Sharing Pepu questions with your peers

upgradeBenefits.title: Upgrading to one of these packages provides the following benefits:
upgradeBenefits.point1: Access to more than 7,000 ministry questions and answers
upgradeBenefits.point2: Access to questions from expert teachers in a special assistance section
upgradeBenefits.point3: Access to flashcards (a practical tool for students to easily access topics)
upgradeBenefits.point4: List of the best students of the month
upgradeBenefits.point5: More supplementary information about yourself, so you can show it to your peers

faq.title_7: How quickly do Pepu questions and answers get updated?
faq.content_7: Currently, all the questions on Pepu are updated by the academic team of teachers in the Pepu team, ensuring continuous improvement for a better learning experience.
faq.title_8: Which levels is Pepu available for?
faq.content_8: Currently, Pepu is available for grades 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 (literary and scientific), plus grade 12 of the English curriculum. We keep expanding it to cover more levels.
faq.title_9: How can I maximize my benefits from Pepu?
faq.content_9: One of the main features of Pepu that benefits you is that Pepu offers the most high-quality and high-quality questions. The first line that you take on Pepu gets the most questions and top-quality questions. The second line, which you can use regularly, gets you ahead of the other lines and increases your chances of getting better grades. The rest of the lines that Pepu offers are for optional use.
faq.title_10: How can I register on Pepu?
faq.content_10: For registration, please watch this video tutorial: [Registration Video](https://www.youtube.com/embed/DIrCREsDaE4)
faq.title_11: How can I take a test on Pepu?
faq.content_11: For taking a test, please watch this video tutorial: [Taking a Test Video](https://www.youtube.com/embed/PeEXAqyqazQ)
faq.title_12: How can I subscribe to a Pepu package?
faq.content_12: For subscribing to a Pepu package, please watch this video tutorial: [Subscription Video](https://www.youtube.com/embed/TNri2w_tFSg)

faq2.title: Frequently asked questions
faq2.sub: Everything you might want to know. Can't find your answer? Message us on Messenger.
faq2.a1: Pepu is a learning app for students. You take exams, find your weak spots, and with Pepu's help understand lessons better and get higher grades.
faq2.a2: Currently, Pepu is available for grades 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 (literary and scientific), plus grade 12 of the English curriculum. We keep expanding it to cover more levels.
faq2.q3: Where do the questions come from?
faq2.a3: Currently, all the questions on Pepu are updated by the academic team of teachers in the Pepu team, ensuring continuous improvement for a better learning experience.
faq2.a4: Downloading the app is free. To unlock the questions and every feature you need a subscription; see the plans and prices on the subscribe page.
faq2.q5: How do I subscribe and pay?
faq2.a5: In the app or at pepu.krd/subscribe: sign in with Google, Apple or your phone number, pick a plan and pay with FIB. On iPhone, subscribe on the website.
faq2.a6: When you get a question wrong or skip it, tap “Pepu, help me” or “Pepu, teach me”. Pepu explains step by step why the right answer is right.
faq2.q7: How does snapping a textbook page work?
faq2.a7: Take a photo of a page; Pepu reads it, sums it up, makes questions and flashcards from it and answers your questions about it.
faq2.q8: What are flashcards and the focus room?
faq2.a8: Flashcards are small cards you review at just the right time so they stick. The focus room has calm music, a study timer and breaks — alone or with friends.
faq2.a9: Take an exam every day to keep your streak going. Studying regularly unlocks new badges.
faq2.q10: Can I study with my friends?
faq2.a10: Yes. Add your friends, share questions and study together.
faq2.q11: Which languages does the app support?
faq2.a11: Pepu is available in Kurdish, Arabic and English.
faq2.q12: How do I get the most out of Pepu?
faq2.a12: One of the main features of Pepu that benefits you is that Pepu offers the most high-quality and high-quality questions. The first line that you take on Pepu gets the most questions and top-quality questions. The second line, which you can use regularly, gets you ahead of the other lines and increases your chances of getting better grades. The rest of the lines that Pepu offers are for optional use.
